tut.tapDesktop: Click the core, or press Space
tut.tapMobile: Tap the core to collect energy
tut.scan: Scan to find a celestial body
tut.merge: Drag one onto the other to merge them
tut.power: Bodies on the board make every tap stronger
tut.upgrade: Buy Core Focus: more energy per tap
tut.goal: Merge your way up to a Galaxy
tut.full: Board full. Merge, or drag a body onto the core for energy
tut.probes: Buy Probe Fleet: probes collect energy without tapping
tut.tapStill: Tapping still adds a lot on top of probes
tut.rarity: Merge two rare bodies for a 50% chance to keep their rarity
tut.reward: Free rewards come back every few minutes
tut.twin: Watch an ad to copy what you just merged
tut.autoScan: Auto Scan buys scans for you. Turn it off to save up for an upgrade
tut.autoMerge: Auto Merge merges pairs for you. Turn it off to keep a pair, for example for a hidden body

finish.title: Galaxy complete!
finish.noBest: Race to a Galaxy in a timed run to set a record

special.rowHint: Galaxies are not the end. Some hide a secret when they meet another world.
